column3: ## Test Article Page Citation and Export
Navigate to an article landing page at /article/<article_id>
Locate the citation / export options on the page
Click on the RIS export option

column4: An .ris file is downloaded containing the article's bibliographic metadata (including title, authors, journal, publication date, and identifiers)
Each author appears once (AU line), even if they have multiple affiliations. RIS does not include affiliations.

column3: Click on the BibTeX export option if available

column4: BibTeX formatted citation data is displayed or downloaded
